svg.title: A transaction being written and saved
svg.desc: A slip from transactions.beancount: 2026-09-12, Corner grocer, Weekly shop; Expenses:Food:Groceries 71.85 EUR; Assets:Bank:Checking -71.85 EUR. The postings sum to 0.00 EUR and the slip is stamped In balance. Beside it, the save steps in order: lock the project, keep a copy to go back to, note the change, write a temporary file to disk, swap it into place, Beancount reads it back, and only then Saved. Sample figures from an invented ledger.
